steep-entry-tension: The surface enters the slope at 74° and 4 slices on its steep part rely on tension at the base (N′ < 0 or a low m_α), which soil cannot take; the factor of safety is then unreliable (higher or lower than with the steep part cut off). A tension crack cutting off the steep part (Options › Crack at base angle, for example 60–70°) removes it.
